description:
Please set up the ad unit with ID 12345 on the delivery domain ads.example.com. The minimum cost‑per‑mil (CPM) floor for this placement should be set to $0.50.  

In addition, include the following custom targeting parameters: the audience age is 30, and the primary interest category is sports.
